title: Trust & Security | Oxira
description: How Oxira protects your site, your payments and your data: HTTPS, DNSSEC, Moyasar payments, password-free sign-in and PDPL commitment.
lead: Your website, your customers and your payments deserve real protection. Here's exactly what we do — no more, no less.

items.d: Every Oxira page and every client site is served over HTTPS, so data between visitors and the site is encrypted.
oxira.sa uses DNSSEC to protect visitors from DNS spoofing, and client sites run on Cloudflare's network, which helps protect against attacks.
Payments are processed by Moyasar, a licensed Saudi payment provider. Card details go directly to them — Oxira never sees or stores card numbers.
You sign in with a one-time link sent to your email instead of a password, so there's no password to leak or reuse.
We collect only what's needed to deliver the service. We don't sell personal data, and we don't use your site visitors' data for advertising.
We register domains only after your payment is confirmed, and invoice renewals in advance so your site doesn't go down unexpectedly.

pdplBody: Oxira is committed to the Saudi Personal Data Protection Law. We handle personal data only for the purposes it was collected for, and we respect your rights over it.
rights: The right to access your personal data
The right to correct your personal data
The right to have your personal data deleted
The right to withdraw your consent
rightsNote: To exercise any of these rights, email us at info@oxira.sa. We'll reply within a reasonable time.
reportBody: Found a vulnerability? Email the details to info@oxira.sa. We appreciate responsible disclosure and will get back to you.
